verdict.rationale: Vestd documents an online exercise flow: the option holder submits an exercise request through Vestd, and the company admin reviews and processes it, confirming valuation and tax/legal considerations. Separately, Vestd documents digital share issuance with automatic Companies House updates and "no paperwork involved." However, nothing shows the employee paying the exercise price within the platform, and nothing explicitly ties the processed exercise to automatic share issuance. Missing for 10: in-platform payment of the exercise price, explicit evidence that exercise triggers share issuance end-to-end, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
